content:
<thought>Retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of oxide compositions using the batch tool with the given energy and count limits, then consolidate the resulting JSON files into a single dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "FeO", "Fe3O4",
    "ZnO", "CuO", "Cu2O", "MnO", "MnO2", "CoO",
    "NiO", "Cr2O3", "MgO", "CaO", "SrO", "BaO",
    "PbO", "SnO2"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "oxide_polymorphs"
}</action_input>
